posts.trend: Gurgaon woman spends 50% of salary on rent to live close to work: ‘Saving my peace’
posts.context: The transition of house-hunting priorities from your early twenties to your early thirties is a lesson in survival.
posts.angle: Prime location no longer means proximity to social life; it means proximity to survival infrastructure.
slides: Your definition of 'prime location' has collapsed.

At 21:
Walking distance to three bars, a metro station, and a momo stall. Split three ways.

At 30:
Within the delivery zone of an app that has fresh coriander at 6 AM.
And you still don't use the balcony.
posts.caption: Your college roommate is still living in the same flat. You are paying for a gated society gym you've seen twice.
posts.rank_verdict: The hook functions as an abstract title card instead of launching directly into the concrete details of the joke.
